scientific_scope: Prospective P4-v1 painted-trail mechanism freeze after permanent P1-v1, P2-v1, and P3-v1 closure and after the P4 independent-evidence and candidate-class decision gates. This record chooses exactly one mathematical realization of the selected broad absolute-signal-dependent bilateral response class before any P4 implementation, simulation, response-target semantic access, target-ranked candidate search, or reserved Y-maze validation access.

oberhauser_wendt_czaczkes_2020.role: Direct evidence that absolute pheromone concentration can alter attraction strength in Lasius niger. It motivates an absolute-evidence dependence but does not set a threshold value or equation.

perna_et_al_2012.role: Cross-species mechanistic evidence for local bilateral Weber/Michelson directional comparison together with an explicitly discussed minimum sensory detection threshold below which average turning should vanish.

czaczkes_gruter_jones_ratnieks_2011.role: Direct Lasius niger evidence that a stronger trail does not necessarily produce a smooth monotonic change in all locomotor endpoints, supporting a parsimonious detection-gate realization over an invented multi-parameter smooth gain law for this first P4 mechanism.

why_this_subclass: It is the simplest exact realization that satisfies the selected P4 class while preserving local bilateral direction.
It directly mirrors the independently documented concept of a minimum detectable total pheromone signal below which turning vanishes.
It introduces one new scientific scale parameter only: theta_detect, the absolute bilateral detection threshold.
It avoids adding an unsupported sigmoid slope, Hill exponent, stochastic response RNG, baseline regularizer, colony effect, path effect, or response-memory state.
It does not reuse P3 target-ranked outcomes to choose its equation or threshold value.
selection_rule.biological_claim_limit: This is a prospective internal model realization, not a claim that a hard deterministic threshold or the exact equation below has been physiologically established in Lasius niger.

mechanism.concept: Each moving ant senses the painted-trail scalar field in deterministic front-left and front-right local sectors. The absolute evidence statistic S=L+R first controls detectability. When S is at or below theta_detect, trail steering is exactly absent. When S exceeds theta_detect, steering direction and normalized magnitude are determined by the bilateral Weber/Michelson contrast (R-L)/(R+L). P4-v1 has no response RNG and no transient lapse state.

field.source_component: Reuse the already-frozen painted-line Gaussian field representation unchanged so P4-v1 isolates the new absolute-detection gate rather than changing external cue geometry at the same time.
field.sigma_field_mm_role: shared field-width structural parameter; no biological value or estimation bound is selected by this gate

sector_sensors.source_geometry_status: source-inspired engineering geometry based on the 1 cm local analysis scale in Perna et al.; not a Lasius niger anatomical estimate
sector_sensors.left_sector: the 90-degree front-left quadrant relative to instantaneous heading
sector_sensors.right_sector: the 90-degree front-right quadrant relative to instantaneous heading

digital_operator.sector_summary: R = arithmetic mean of C(p_R(i,j)) over 32 samples; L = arithmetic mean of C(p_L(i,j)) over 32 samples
digital_operator.weighting: equal weights; sqrt radial transform makes radial bins equal-area under the polar midpoint approximation

absolute_detection.theta_units: dimensionless field-concentration units under the frozen dose-ratio field representation
absolute_detection.gate: G(S;theta_detect) = 0 when S <= theta_detect; G = 1 when S > theta_detect
absolute_detection.boundary_rule: Equality is subthreshold: S == theta_detect produces exactly zero trail steering.
absolute_detection.theta_detect_role: shared absolute bilateral detection-threshold structural parameter; no biological value or future estimation bound is selected by this gate
absolute_detection.reason_for_sum: The same two local bilateral sector summaries used for direction provide the minimum sufficient absolute-evidence statistic; summing them adds no new sensor geometry or hidden environmental input.

directional_transduction.zero_or_subthreshold_rule: When L+R <= theta_detect, W is exactly zero.
directional_transduction.equal_signal_rule: When L == R, W == 0 whether below or above threshold.
directional_transduction.conditional_positive_scale_invariance: For any finite a>0 such that both L+R and a*(L+R) remain strictly above theta_detect, the directional ratio is unchanged. Crossing theta_detect intentionally breaks global positive scale invariance.

steering.sign_convention: Positive W means the right sector has more pheromone and applies positive rightward steering using the existing painted-trail sign convention.
steering.kappa_trail_per_s_role: shared steering-gain structural parameter; no biological value or future estimation bound is selected by this gate

mechanism.canonical_update_order: When active and above threshold, apply omega_trail*dt to heading immediately before the unchanged canonical Ant.update step, preserving the previously audited painted-trail update ordering.
mechanism.moving_step_rule: Evaluate painted-trail steering only when the ant is not finished, is not already paused, and a preview of the canonical pause hazard indicates the ant will move; preview the hazard by cloning canonical biology RNG state without mutation.

engineering_only_reachability_values.value_rationale: sigma=8 mm and kappa=4 s^-1 reuse pre-target engineering reachability values only. theta_detect=0.25 is a new engineering-only value chosen before P4 simulation because, under the frozen normalized Gaussian field, any dose_ratio <=0.10 guarantees L<=0.10 and R<=0.10 everywhere and therefore L+R<=0.20<0.25, giving an exact global subthreshold identity case, while nominal-dose synthetic sector cases can be chosen above threshold. It is not a biological threshold estimate and may not define a later estimation bound.

invariances_and_forbidden_inputs: No signal-independent p_lapse or P2 transient-engagement state.
No stochastic detection or response RNG in P4-v1.
No sigmoid slope, Hill exponent, epsilon, denominator regularizer, or soft-gate parameter.
No repulsive or sign-reversing pheromone state beyond the instantaneous left-right sign of the local field difference.
No trail bearing, target direction, arena goal, or future path knowledge.
No change to canonical pause, speed noise, angular noise, contacts, boundary logic, locomotion state, or biology RNG stream.
No H2, H3, H4, or H5 mechanism combination in P4-v1.
No P1, P2, or P3 official result semantics may be used for P4 implementation tuning.
No reserved Y-maze geometry, outcomes, or treatment labels.

implementation_gate.next_step: A separate P4 implementation plus reference-free reachability execution gate may implement exactly this frozen mechanism after this record is audited and merged. It may not access response-target semantics, P1/P2/P3 official result semantics, or reserved Y-maze validation.

estimation_firewall.rule: No P4 estimation bounds, candidate panel, objective, folds, seeds, trial budget, comparator, identifiability rule, nuisance policy, or promotion threshold is selected by this mechanism freeze.
